caption: The drawing depicts a man standing on a small wooden platform with four wheels. He is dressed in a red hat, a red vest with buttons, a dark blue or black jacket, a light orange scarf tied at the neck, white trousers, and tall black boots. He has a mustache and dark hair that extends to his neck. Slung over his left shoulder is a dark satchel or bag. He holds a green cabbage in his left hand and a long rifle or musket in his right hand, which rests on the platform, with the barrel facing downward. The platform is rectangular and has rounded wheels at each corner. The overall composition is centered, with the figure taking up most of the vertical space of the drawing, which is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Figure
